name: Coloring Book
description: Tap to fill drawings with colour: house, cat, fish, rocket and more. Save your art to the gallery.
prompt: A coloring book for kids with at least 8 simple line drawings drawn in code, like a house, a cat, a fish, a car, a flower, a rocket, tap an area to fill it with the chosen colour from a big palette, undo, and save the picture with Acornix.files.export.
author: gonzaroman
